Alex (Marketing): Quick heads-up — benchmark blog is greenlit for publish at 16:00 PT but legal requested a 30m embargo shift. Can everyone confirm we can move assets? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya (PR): Got it. Who requested the shift? Marta?
Marta (Legal): Yep — small data wording tweak flagged during final pass. Need embargo until 16:30 PT to make the change and re-run the quote approvals.
Alex (Marketing): Ok — that pushes the publish window. Priya, can you notify the press list and partners about a 30m slip? Use the soft-notify template (no details).
Priya (PR): On it. I'll send the short update to the press list and ping top 5 outlets. Draft: "Small scheduling update — we will publish at 16:30 PT. Will share link then." Approve?
Jordan (CEO): Approve. Keep messaging minimal. No extra context.
Sam (Eng): Build is baked but we need to rotate the short demo clip hosting URL — it expires at 16:15 PT. Can we extend or swap to the S3 fallback?
Ben (Ops): I can rotate to S3 fallback. Doing it now. Will post confirmation when done.
EmbargoBot: Embargo updated: new embargo lift time 2026-03-23 23:30:00 UTC (16:30 PT). Notifying channels: #marketing, #press-ops.
Ben (Ops): S3 fallback live. Demo clip URL: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/demo-v2.mp4 (internal link).
Priya (PR): Sent press update to top list and partners. CC'd newsroom@redwood. Will follow with link at lift.
Alex (Marketing): Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) Social assets update — swap the screenshot showing latency numbers (we adjusted a label). 2) Design to queue final hero image with the new timestamp. Who can own?
Priya (PR): I can coordinate with design for hero image. Marta, any legal signoff needed on the asset text swap?
Marta (Legal): Quick check only — swap the caption from "avg latency" to "p99 latency" — fine. No extra approvals.
Sam (Eng): Will push updated latency screenshot to /assets/benchmarks/latest.png in 5 mins.
Alex (Marketing): Perfect. After assets swapped, Priya — please confirm so we can lift embargo on EmbargoBot.
Priya (PR): Confirmed when design uploads are live.
Ben (Ops): Monitoring in place for traffic spike. I set a temporary alert threshold to 3x baseline for the first 30 mins post-publish.
Jordan (CEO): Thanks team. If any top outlet calls, I'll be available for quick ons. Priya, please route to me if needed.
Priya (PR): Copy. I'll ping if any outreach needs executive quote or follow-up.
Alex (Marketing): Final checklist before 16:30 PT: assets swapped, press notified, demo URL stable, alerts set, legal ok. Reply with :thumbsup: when you have your item.
Sam (Eng): :thumbsup: assets uploaded at /assets/benchmarks/latest.png
Marta (Legal): :thumbsup: legal cleared caption text
Ben (Ops): :thumbsup: demo fallback live, alerts configured
Priya (PR): :thumbsup: press notified, design queued and uploaded
EmbargoBot: Embargo lift scheduled at 1764127020 (16:30 PT). Will post lift in #marketing and ping press list at that time.
Alex (Marketing): Great work. We'll use this thread for any late blockers. If anything changes, ping here and I'll escalate.
Priya (PR): Will share final link in thread at lift time.
Jordan (CEO): Appreciate the quick pivot everyone.
Alex (Marketing): End of thread for now — standby until 16:30 PT.
